title: Surface CI probe annotations and streamed footer headings
problem: CI checks failures in Footer Chromium probe (runs 40387187938, 40409123749, 40423130342) write diagnostics only to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, leaving public check-run annotations blank when raw logs return HTTP 403. Meanwhile scripts/probe-end.mjs samples main h1 on /dashboard after a fixed 450ms pause while loading.tsx can still stream a headingless skeleton, scripts/probe-motion-signed-in.sh lacks >48-char TMPDIR shortening, and checks (1039s warm in 40420670837) has <3m headroom under 20m.

Implement scripts/ci-probe-annotate.mjs (reusing escapeData from ./e2e-annotate.mjs without modifying scripts/e2e-annotate.mjs) to post-process or run non-TAP CI steps, preserve exact nonzero exit codes under pipefail, write bounded escaped GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY sections when set, and emit GitHub workflow ::error title=<step>::... annotations to stdout (escaping %, \r, \n, : and , in properties) with failed not ok - / probe: lines or crash tail plus bounded next-start.log tail (including missing-log handling).

Wire scripts/ci-probe-annotate.mjs into .github/workflows/ci.yml for Real CPU camera and privacy verifier, Motion probe, signed in, Footer walk, and Footer Chromium probe while retaining exact bash scripts/walk-end.sh and bash scripts/probe-end.sh invocations required by lib/end.test.ts and scripts/ci-workflow.test.mjs. Update checks.timeout-minutes to 25 and add timeout-minutes: 12 on E2E against next start with an updated comment citing measured run 40420670837 timings (1039s total: E2E 501s, camera 79s, signed-in motion 171s, footer probe 71s).

In scripts/probe-end.mjs around the local 390x844 reduced-motion 403 exit check, replace the fixed 450ms pause before reading main h1 with a bounded 10s observation for a rendered non-empty main h1 on /projects or /dashboard so app/(site)/(app)/dashboard/loading.tsx's headingless Suspense skeleton cannot race layout hydration; keep all existing probe assertions and console/network error checks intact. In scripts/probe-motion-signed-in.sh, normalize unset/empty/>48-char TMPDIR to /tmp matching scripts/probe-end.sh.

Add scripts/ci-probe-annotate.test.mjs (real subprocess exit-7 and exit-0 fixtures, ::error property/data escaping, crash without not ok -, and missing next-start.log) and scripts/probe-end-stream.test.mjs (1.5s delayed streamed /dashboard heading positive control and missing-heading timeout negative control). Update scripts/ci-workflow.test.mjs so its temporary workdir fixture exercises the updated Footer Chromium probe step and asserts ::error output alongside GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Run all verification commands, commit with explicit GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Otohime' GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='quiinthieu@gmail.com' GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Otohime' GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='quiinthieu@gmail.com' (pm-270/<task_id>: imperative subject, no Co-Authored-By), push origin HEAD, and stop at the push.
non_goals: weakening or deleting any Footer walk, Footer Chromium probe, or signed-in motion assertion or console/network error check
modifying scripts/e2e-annotate.mjs, scripts/vercel-deploy.sh, or lib/end.test.ts owned by sibling plans
querying CI or live production endpoints in a loop inside the SWE run
acceptance_criteria: Failures in CI camera, signed-in motion, Footer walk, or Footer Chromium probe preserve their exact nonzero exit status while emitting workflow-escaped ::error annotations with the failing assertion and bounded server log tail, probe-motion-signed-in.sh normalizes >48-char TMPDIR paths to /tmp, checks has a measured 25m job / 12m E2E step budget, and probe-end.mjs observes streamed /dashboard main h1 headings deterministically within 10s while failing when headings stay absent.
